item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We refuse to accept that future. Preventing it must come before the race to build it.

2. We cannot build superintelligent AI first and ask how to stop its misuse later. If it is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We demand prevention, not promises after the damage is done.

3. We reject a race to superintelligence that puts human lives on the line. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must stop that future before it becomes our reality.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We face a stark choice about the future we are building. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We will not treat those lives as an acceptable price for technological progress. We must act before dangerous capabilities are deployed, not wait for a catastrophe to force our hand. That means demanding enforceable limits, public accountability, and the willingness to stop development rather than gamble with human lives. We reject the idea that this race is inevitable. Together, we can choose prevention over reckless acceleration—and we must make that choice now.
